719-2638-3510-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-2638-3510-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

6351-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
6351-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Repeat.

2645-2872-3430-6256.easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2872-3430-6256.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Muraganda Raceway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

151-5261-7170.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-5261-7170.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-5261-7170.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Living Brain.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

147-1893-2034.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1893-2034.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

277-2493-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-2493-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-2493-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Archaeomancer and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

967-3809-6441-7087-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

586-4247-5626-5687.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

728-6529-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4050-7818.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4050-7818.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

851-2557-6441-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1497-2173-5220-7492.description:
Cast Wild Cantor by paying its mana cost.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1074-4222-7824.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping King Macar.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling target creature and creating two Gold artifact tokens.
Activate the Golds by sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat as desired.
You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1912-7426-7628-7737.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1912-7426-7628-7737.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Biomancer's Familiar and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

618-4456-6556-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying at most {1}{R} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
618-4456-6556-7494.notes: If you control more creatures with power 4 or greater, the starting cost is reduced by {1} and you'll net infinite red mana.

1352-1869-5231.description:
Cast Mistbind Clique by paying {3}{U}.
Mistbind Clique enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Mistbind Clique with haste.
The token Mistbind Clique enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Mistbind Clique.
The nontoken Mistbind Clique leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Mistbind Clique trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Mistbind Clique token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Mistbind Clique from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-3311-7307.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-3311-7307.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Raphael, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Snake Umbra triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3564-4275-5329-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
3564-4275-5329-6798.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
3564-4275-5329-6798.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

1492-4195-4316-4574.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-4195-4316-4574.description:
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Welding Jar from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

328-2173-2438-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2173-2438-5220.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3668-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Flesh Duplicate
3668-5299-5466.description:
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Flesh Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Flesh Duplicate's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Flesh Duplicate's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Flesh Duplicate's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with one to three time counters on it

1618-2092-2806-5195--63.description:
Cast the noncreature permanent by paying {0}.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying at most {1}, removing three time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Reality Strobe, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand, and then exiling Reality Strobe with three time counters on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1618-2575-6496--97.easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
1618-2575-6496--97.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Mastery and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
1618-2575-6496--97.description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Temporal Mastery by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Temporal Mastery and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Mastery, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Temporal Mastery and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Temporal Mastery and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Temporal Mastery's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
1618-2575-6496--97.notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

3389-4050-5043-6441.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

224-2157-2653-5954.notablePrerequisites: Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
224-2157-2653-5954.description:
Cast Overlord of the Hauntwoods by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Nissa and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Reoslve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Romana II.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 3.

877-1374-5910-6091.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Archmage of Runes and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

2028-5231--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2028-5231--5.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Hexavus' second ability by paying {1} and removing the -1/-1 counter from the persist creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hexavus.
Repeat.

147-1223-5256.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
147-1223-5256.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities, causing any number of players to mill that many cards.

1636-3678-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-3678-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2498-2935-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2498-2935-4691.description:
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat as desired.
Resolve all Ethereal Champion abilities.

372-1917-5276.description:
Cast Touch the Spirit Realm by paying {2}{W}.
When Touch the Spirit Realm enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Leonin Relic-Warder to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Touch the Spirit Realm.
Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Leonin Relic-Warder and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Touch the Spirit Realm to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

116-1432-2869.notablePrerequisites:
Kiora's Follower and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
116-1432-2869.description:
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower and any other creature you control.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.

1679-2302-4050-4963.notablePrerequisites:
"Blue" chosen with Painter's Servant.
You have a way to draw a card.
1679-2302-4050-4963.description:
Activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, replacing your next card draw with creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Draw a card, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token instead.
The Bear token enters the battlefield, triggering Dire Undercurrents' first ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Bear token, adding {1}.
Activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, replacing your next card draw with creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Resolve the Dire Undercurrents trigger from step 3, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2436-2816.notablePrerequisites: Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
2436-2816.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Activate Marwyn by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
